===== SYSTEM =====
You are a medicinal chemistry oral bioavailability analog evidence analyst. Reason about whether analog evidence for one aspect of oral bioavailability is transferable to the query molecule. No tools are available for this branch. Use the supplied assay-transfer likelihoods as the best available transfer estimates. Return only valid JSON.

===== USER =====
## INSTRUCTIONS
1. Each ranked entry is one of the top-k assay records across all candidate molecules, with a transfer likelihood (a 0-1 model estimate).
2. Trust these likelihoods as they are the best estimates available.
3. Based on the transfer liklihoods, determine the implications for the query's oral bioavailability.
4. Do not treat qualitative, relative, or surrogate_proxy evidence as a direct absolute F% measurement.
5. Return a single JSON object matching the required schema shown below.

## ASPECT OF ORAL BIOAVAILABILITY
This aspect covers Fg, gut-wall availability: the fraction of absorbed drug that escapes the intestinal wall. Judge whether the neighbor evidence on intestinal efflux transport (e.g. P-gp) and gut-wall/intestinal metabolism transfers to the query and how it bears on the query's oral bioavailability.

## QUERY MOLECULE
- SMILES: COc1ccnc(CS(=O)c2nc3ccc(OC(F)F)cc3[nH]2)c1OC
